articles.title_en: How helpful are the “hidden costs of food systems” numbers?
articles.title_cn: “食品系统的隐性成本”数字有多大帮助？
articles.abstract_en: The “hidden costs of foods systems” calculations reported by the Food and Land Use Coalition, the Food System Economic Commission and the UN Food and Agriculture Organization may not provide helpful policy guidance for the transformation of food systems for both economic and political reasons. Economically, the hidden costs numbers exclude countervailing social benefits which imply unavoidable trade-offs across policy objectives. They also aggregate costs that are fundamentally different in their economic character and require different policy approaches, while including some costs that are not attributable to food systems at all. Politically, the headline numbers risk impeding transformative change because they identify food systems participants – particularly farmers –in terms of the damage they inflict while ignoring critical benefits they confer, and implicate them in social failings for which they are not primarily responsible. However, the hidden costs numbers can be useful if integrated into a more balanced assessment of the performance of food systems. Such an approach could support a positive agenda which engages the actors whose contributions will be indispensable.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品与土地利用联盟、食品系统经济委员会和联合国粮食及农业组织报告的“食品系统隐性成本”计算，可能无法为食品系统的转型提供有用的政策指导，原因既有经济方面的，也有政治方面的。在经济上，隐性成本数字排除了抵消性的社会效益，这暗示了政策目标之间不可避免的权衡取舍。它们还汇总了在经济性质上根本不同、需要不同政策方法的成本，同时包含了一些根本不属于食品系统的成本。在政治上，这些头条数字可能阻碍变革性进展，因为它们将食品系统的参与者——尤其是农民——定义为造成损害的一方，而忽略了他们带来的关键利益，并将他们牵连到并非主要责任的社会失败中。然而，如果将这些隐性成本数字整合到对食品系统绩效的更平衡评估中，它们可能是有用的。这种方法可以支持一个积极的议程，吸引那些贡献不可或缺的行动者参与。

articles.title_en: The emerging short-form video platforms improve household dietary diversity of rural residents: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 新兴短视频平台改善农村居民家庭膳食多样性：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Hidden hunger and malnutrition threaten rural households in developing countries. Therefore, an effective and low-cost strategy is urgently required to improve the dietary diversity of rural households. Short-form video platforms (SVPs) are emerging media that can deliver diet-related information, and their potential impact on the dietary diversity of rural households cannot be neglected. Based on primary data collected from rural households in China, this study employs the IV-Poisson model to explore whether SVPs improve the dietary diversity of rural households, uses the IV-Probit model to examine whether SVPs encourage rural residents to consume food groups that are not self-produced, and applies the endogenous-treatment Poisson regression (ETPR) model to identify the heterogeneous effects of SVP participation on the dietary diversity of rural households with different distances from the county center. The results reveal that household cooks’ participation in SVPs significantly increases the dietary diversity of rural households. Specifically, households in which cooks participate in SVPs have 29.5% higher household dietary diversity scores than those in which cooks do not. The results indicate that household cooks’ participation in SVPs encourages rural residents to consume food groups that are not self-produced, thus improving their dietary diversity. In addition, the results indicate that household cooks’ participation in SVPs has a greater positive effect on the dietary diversity of rural households closer to the county center compared to those farther from the center.
articles.abstract_cn: 隐性饥饿和营养不良威胁着发展中国家的农村家庭。因此，迫切需要一种有效且低成本的策略来改善农村家庭的膳食多样性。短视频平台（SVPs）是能够传递饮食相关信息的新兴媒体，其对农村家庭膳食多样性的潜在影响不容忽视。基于从中国农村家庭收集的一手数据，本研究采用IV-Poisson模型探讨SVPs是否改善农村家庭的膳食多样性，使用IV-Probit模型检验SVPs是否鼓励农村居民消费非自产食物组，并应用内生处理泊松回归（ETPR）模型识别SVP参与对距县城中心不同距离的农村家庭膳食多样性的异质性影响。结果表明，家庭厨师参与SVPs显著提高了农村家庭的膳食多样性。具体而言，厨师参与SVPs的家庭的膳食多样性得分比厨师未参与的家庭高29.5%。结果还表明，家庭厨师参与SVPs鼓励农村居民消费非自产食物组，从而改善其膳食多样性。此外，结果还表明，与距离县城中心较远的农村家庭相比，家庭厨师参与SVPs对距离县城中心较近的农村家庭的膳食多样性具有更大的正向影响。

articles.title_en: Understanding the barriers to purchasing healthier, more environmentally sustainable food for people living with obesity and varying experiences of food insecurity in the UK
articles.title_cn: 理解英国肥胖及不同程度食物不安全人群购买更健康、更环境可持续食品的障碍
articles.abstract_en: In westernised countries, food insecurity (FI) is robustly associated with low diet quality, and obesity. Grocery stores are one promising arena for interventions to facilitate purchasing of healthier, more environmentally sustainable food. However, we currently lack understanding of the barriers experienced by people living with obesity (PLWO) and FI when shopping for such food. Using an online survey (N = 583), adults residing in England or Scotland with a body mass index of ≥ 30 kg/m2 self-reported on FI, diet quality, and their experiences of shopping in a grocery store for healthy and environmentally sustainable food. Participants also ranked different grocery store interventions on their helpfulness in supporting healthier, more environmentally sustainable purchasing. Structural equation modelling revealed that greater experiences of FI were directly associated with greater experiences of barriers from the food environment (e.g., price), food preparation practices, lower healthy diet knowledge and physical ill-health. Moreover, greater experiences of FI were indirectly associated with lower diet quality via mental ill-health and greater experiences of anticipated stigma associated with being food insecure. Grocery store interventions based on price/ incentivisation were ranked most helpful in supporting healthier, more environmentally sustainable purchasing. These findings highlight the challenges faced by PLWO and with greater experiences of FI when shopping for healthy and environmentally sustainable food. Findings also underscore the need for policy development relating to price and affordability at a population-level, and for policymakers and healthcare professionals to consider how to address mental health and how to minimise anticipated stigma experienced by this vulnerable group.
articles.abstract_cn: 在西方化国家，食物不安全（FI）与低饮食质量和肥胖密切相关。杂货店是促进购买更健康、更环境可持续食品的干预措施的一个有前景的场所。然而，目前我们缺乏对肥胖人群（PLWO）和FI人群在购买此类食品时所遇障碍的理解。通过一项在线调查（N = 583），居住在英格兰或苏格兰、体重指数≥ 30 kg/m2的成年人自我报告了FI、饮食质量以及他们在杂货店购买健康和环境可持续食品的经历。参与者还对不同的杂货店干预措施在支持更健康、更环境可持续购买方面的帮助程度进行了排序。结构方程模型显示，更高程度的FI经历与来自食品环境（如价格）、食品准备实践、较低的健康饮食知识和身体疾病方面的更大障碍经历直接相关。此外，更高程度的FI经历通过心理健康问题和与食物不安全相关的预期污名经历，间接与较低的饮食质量相关。基于价格/激励的杂货店干预措施在支持更健康、更环境可持续购买方面被列为最有帮助。这些发现强调了PLWO和FI经历较多人群在购买健康和环境可持续食品时所面临的挑战。研究结果还强调了在人口层面制定与价格和可负担性相关的政策的必要性，并提示政策制定者和医疗保健专业人员考虑如何解决心理健康问题以及如何最小化这一弱势群体所经历的预期污名。

articles.title_en: Trade protection via tariff rate quota administration
articles.title_cn: 关税配额管理下的贸易保护
articles.abstract_en: In January 2022, the first dispute settlement panel convened under the United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) ruled that administration procedures for Canadian tariff rate quotas (TRQs) on U.S. dairy products violated Canadian trade obligations. Canada subsequently published new dairy quota administration policies to comply with the ruling. Using a dataset with monthly bilateral dairy trade flows at the 6-digit level from January 2014 to October 2023, we empirically assess the economic outcomes associated with this dispute from the perspective of the U.S. dairy industry. We find that — even under Canada’s original quota administration procedures — Canadian dairy TRQ concessions represented meaningful trade liberalization relative to the pre-USMCA status quo. However, in light of Canada’s revised procedures following the panel ruling, U.S. exports to Canada experienced a substantial increase for affected dairy products. This indicates that Canada’s original quota administration procedures represented a “binding” trade restriction beyond the negotiated quota. USMCA dispute settlement procedures effectively worked to remove the barrier.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2022年一月，根据《美国-墨西哥-加拿大协定》（USMCA）设立的首个争端解决专家组裁定，加拿大对美国乳制品的关税配额（TRQs）管理程序违反了加拿大的贸易义务。加拿大随后公布了新的乳制品配额管理政策以遵守该裁决。利用2014年一月至2023年十月期间月度双边乳制品贸易流量的6位码数据集，我们从美国乳制品行业的角度实证评估了这一争端相关的经济结果。我们发现，即使在加拿大原有的配额管理程序下，加拿大的乳制品关税配额减让相对于USMCA之前的现状也代表了有意义的贸易自由化。然而，鉴于专家组裁决后加拿大修订的程序，美国对加拿大的受影响乳制品出口出现了显著增长。这表明加拿大原有的配额管理程序构成了超出谈判配额的“约束性”贸易限制。USMCA争端解决程序有效地消除了这一障碍。

articles.title_en: Urban food policy councils as politicized spaces: The case of Arusha, Tanzania
articles.title_cn: 城市食品政策委员会作为政治化空间：坦桑尼亚阿鲁沙的案例
articles.abstract_en: Informal food vendors constitute a significant portion of the workforce in Arusha, Tanzania, and play a crucial role in the local food system. Despite their importance, these vendors lack political and social agency, resulting in their underrepresentation in decision-making processes. This study explores the potential of urban food policy councils (UFPCs) to support these vendors, focusing on the Arusha Sustainable Food System Platform. Recently, the platform faced a government directive to relocate street vendors without their participation. This case study examines the platform’s response to this directive.
articles.abstract_cn: 在坦桑尼亚阿鲁沙，非正规食品商贩构成了劳动力中的重要部分，并在当地食品系统中扮演关键角色。尽管他们很重要，但这些商贩缺乏政治和社会能动性，导致他们在决策过程中代表性不足。本研究探讨了城市食品政策委员会（UFPCs）支持这些商贩的潜力，重点关注阿鲁沙可持续食品系统平台。近期，该平台面临政府指令，要求在没有商贩参与的情况下迁移街头商贩。本案例研究考察了该平台对这一指令的回应。

articles.title_en: Much ado about nothing? An empirical analysis of consumer behaviour in the presence of ‘dual food quality’
articles.title_cn: 无事生非？‘双重食品质量’存在下的消费者行为实证分析
articles.abstract_en: Marketing food products with slightly different compositions as identical across countries is a common practice in the food industry. While food companies argue that different versions reflect taste preferences, some Central and Eastern European consumers allege that multinational companies sell lower quality products using the same brand name and packaging as in Western European countries. The political attention gathered by this practice, exemplified by the dual food quality (DFQ) debate in the European Union (EU), has largely neglected how the presence of DFQ affects consumers’ purchase decisions. This study aims to help fill this gap. Additionally, it examines the impact of a policy intervention consisting of a ‘made for’ claim and the role of the brand name on consumer choices. Through online discrete-choice experiments and laboratory tasting and rating experiments in six EU countries, no systematic support is found for either the industry’s or the consumers’ arguments. Results also indicate that a policy requiring consumers to be informed about the destination market of different versions would increase consumers’ valuation of domestic products, while at the same time improving transparency and avoiding misleading consumers.
articles.abstract_cn: 在食品行业中，将成分略有不同的食品产品作为相同产品在不同国家销售是一种常见做法。虽然食品公司辩称不同版本反映了口味偏好，但一些中欧和东欧消费者声称，跨国公司使用与西欧国家相同的品牌名称和包装销售质量较低的产品。这一做法引发的政治关注，以欧盟（EU）中的双重食品质量（DFQ）辩论为例，在很大程度上忽视了DFQ的存在如何影响消费者的购买决策。本研究旨在帮助填补这一空白。此外，本研究还考察了由‘专为’声明组成的政策干预的影响以及品牌名称在消费者选择中的作用。通过在六个欧盟国家进行的在线离散选择实验和实验室品尝与评分实验，未发现对行业或消费者论点的系统性支持。结果还表明，要求消费者了解不同版本目标市场的政策将提高消费者对国内产品的估值，同时提高透明度并避免误导消费者。

articles.title_en: Assessing consumers’ valuation for Front-of-Package ‘Health’ labeling under FDA guidelines
articles.title_cn: 评估FDA指南下消费者对包装正面“健康”标签的估值
articles.abstract_en: Suboptimal diets contribute significantly to diet-related chronic diseases and mortality in the United States. To address this, Front-of-Pack (FOP) labels have been proposed to help consumers make healthier food choices. In 2022, the FDA introduced 15 potential health labels aimed at providing critical information and nudging consumers toward healthier food choices, yet the effects of these labels on consumer preferences remain ambiguous. Using the Becker–DeGroot–Marschak mechanism in a laboratory experiment, this study investigates the influence of health and taste labels, and information provision, on consumer willingness to pay (WTP) for yogurt qualifying for the FDA-endorsed health label. Findings indicate that health labels alone reduce WTP, potentially due to perceived compromises on taste and skepticism towards health claims. However, the addition of credible information regarding FDA qualification mitigates these negative effects. Exploratory subsample analyses reveal that the health label is discounted among consumers who are nutritionally knowledgeable, health-conscious, pleasure driven, and frequent label users. However, providing information about the health label mitigates this discount among the former three types of consumers. The study underscores the importance of providing credible, detailed information and targeted educational campaigns to enhance the effectiveness of health labels. These insights can inform policymakers and stakeholders in developing more effective food labeling strategies to promote healthier dietary choices and improve public health outcomes. By unraveling the nuances of how consumers respond to health and taste labels, our research offers valuable guidance for designing labeling strategies that resonate with consumer values and preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 次优饮食显著导致美国饮食相关慢性疾病和死亡率。为解决这一问题，包装正面（FOP）标签被提出以帮助消费者做出更健康的食品选择。在2022年，FDA引入了15种潜在健康标签，旨在提供关键信息并引导消费者选择更健康的食品，但这些标签对消费者偏好的影响仍不明确。本研究采用Becker-DeGroot-Marschak机制进行实验室实验，探讨健康标签、口味标签及信息提供对消费者对符合FDA认可健康标签的酸奶支付意愿（WTP）的影响。研究发现，仅健康标签会降低WTP，可能是由于消费者对口味妥协的感知及对健康声明的怀疑。然而，增加关于FDA资格的可靠信息可缓解这些负面影响。探索性子样本分析显示，健康标签在具有营养知识、健康意识、享乐驱动及频繁使用标签的消费者中被折价。但提供健康标签信息可缓解前三类消费者的折价现象。本研究强调了提供可靠、详细信息及针对性教育活动以增强健康标签有效性的重要性。这些见解可为政策制定者和利益相关者提供指导，以制定更有效的食品标签策略，促进更健康的饮食选择并改善公共健康结果。通过揭示消费者对健康和口味标签反应的细微差别，我们的研究为设计符合消费者价值观和偏好的标签策略提供了宝贵指导。

articles.title_en: Analysis of the Italian regulatory framework on the welfare of aquatic organisms, with a focus on live crustaceans
articles.title_cn: 意大利水生生物福利监管框架分析，重点关注活体甲壳类动物
articles.abstract_en: The European Union regulatory framework for the welfare of aquatic organisms (AOW), live seafood (LSW) and live crustaceans intended for human consumption (LCW) is still in its nascent stages. Member States have tackled the subject with different regulatory approach, represented in Italy, by municipal regulations. The present study was designed to provide an overview of the municipal regulations pertaining to AOW, LSW, and LCW issued in Italy to date. A search was conducted on Google from December 2023 to March 2024 using specific keywords. The analysis of the regulations entailed the scrutiny of provisions concerning AOW and LSW during transport, maintenance, display and, additionally, LCW during stunning and slaughter. A total of 771 municipal regulations on animal welfare issued from 2001 to 2023 were collected. A total of 542 provisions concerning AOW were identified, while 234 and 181 provisions also addressed LSW and LCW, respectively. As regards LCW, specific regulations included the prohibition of the claws banding (85.1%), slaughter prior to sale (59.1%), and boiling of live crustaceans (33.1%). Conversely, the obligation to slaughter before sale (12.1%), after stunning (10.5%) and out of sight of the consumer (5%) were reported. The divergent and generally not scientifically-based nature of the regulations suggests limitations of the Italian approach in AOW, LSW and LCW management. In anticipation of the risk assessment-based revision of EU legislation on AOW, the results provide an updated basis for the drafting of national technical guidelines, including species-specific control checklists, for the monitoring of LCW along the entire supply chain.
articles.abstract_cn: 欧盟关于水生生物福利（AOW）、供人食用的活海鲜（LSW）和活体甲壳类动物（LCW）的监管框架仍处于起步阶段。成员国以不同的监管方式处理该问题，在意大利表现为市政法规。本研究旨在概述意大利迄今发布的与AOW、LSW和LCW相关的市政法规。使用特定关键词在Google上从2023年十二月至2024年三月进行了搜索。对法规的分析涉及审查关于运输、维持、展示期间AOW和LSW的规定，以及击晕和屠宰期间LCW的规定。共收集了2001年至2023年间发布的771项关于动物福利的市政法规。共识别出542项涉及AOW的规定，其中234项和181项分别涉及LSW和LCW。关于LCW，具体规定包括禁止钳子捆绑（85.1%）、销售前屠宰（59.1%）和活煮甲壳类动物（33.1%）。相反，销售前屠宰（12.1%）、击晕后屠宰（10.5%）和消费者视线外屠宰（5%）的义务被报告。法规的分歧性和普遍缺乏科学依据表明意大利在AOW、LSW和LCW管理方法上的局限性。鉴于基于风险评估的欧盟AOW立法修订预期，结果为起草国家技术指南（包括物种特定控制检查表）提供了最新基础，用于监测整个供应链中的LCW。

articles.title_en: Decompose food price disparities in China: Evidence from wholesale markets
articles.title_cn: 分解中国食品价格差异：来自批发市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines regional variations in food prices in China and the underlying factors contributing to these disparities. Leveraging administrative data from agricultural wholesale markets, we construct spatial price indices and reveal consistent monthly trends in disparities. Using our proposed decomposition method, we identify livestock products, particularly beef and pork, as the main components driving regional food price differences. We examine the role of local supply–demand factors in explaining spatial food price variations and find that local gasoline prices are a significant contributor to food price disparity. A one percent increase in local gasoline prices leads to a 0.6 percent rise in local food prices and exacerbates spatial food price disparities by 0.5–1.0 percent. These results highlight the importance of considering transportation costs and regional supply–demand dynamics in understanding food price variations across regions. Our findings have implications for policy aiming to address regional food price disparities and ensure food affordability.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了中国食品价格的区域差异及其背后的影响因素。利用农产品批发市场的行政数据，我们构建了空间价格指数，并揭示了差异中一致的月度趋势。通过我们提出的分解方法，我们识别出畜产品，特别是牛肉和猪肉，是驱动区域食品价格差异的主要组成部分。我们考察了当地供需因素在解释空间食品价格变动中的作用，并发现当地汽油价格是食品价格差异的重要贡献因素。当地汽油价格每上涨百分之一，会导致当地食品价格上涨0.6%，并加剧空间食品价格差异0.5-1.0%。这些结果强调了在理解跨区域食品价格变动时考虑运输成本和区域供需动态的重要性。我们的发现对旨在解决区域食品价格差异和确保食品可负担性的政策具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Coping or hoping? Livelihood diversification and food insecurity in the COVID-19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: 应对还是寄望？COVID-19疫情期间的生计多样化与粮食不安全
articles.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between livelihood diversification and food insecurity amid the COVID-19 pandemic. Our analysis uses household panel data from Ethiopia, Malawi, and Nigeria in which the first round was collected immediately prior to the pandemic and extends through multiple rounds of monthly data collection during the pandemic. Using this pre- and post-outbreak data, and guided by a pre-analysis plan, we estimate conditional associations between livelihood diversification and food insecurity. Our results do not support the hypothesis that livelihood diversification correlates with household resilience. Though income diversification may serve as an effective coping mechanism for small-scale shocks, we find that for a disaster on the scale of the pandemic this strategy is not effective. Policymakers looking to prepare for the increased occurrence of large-scale disasters will need to grapple with the fact that coping strategies that gave people hope in the past may fail them as they try to cope with the future.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了COVID-19疫情期间生计多样化与粮食不安全之间的关系。我们的分析使用了来自埃塞俄比亚、马拉维和尼日利亚的家庭面板数据，其中第一轮数据在疫情爆发前立即收集，并延伸至疫情期间多轮月度数据收集。利用这些疫情前后的数据，并在预分析计划的指导下，我们估计了生计多样化与粮食不安全之间的条件关联。我们的结果不支持生计多样化与家庭韧性相关的假设。尽管收入多样化可能作为小规模冲击的有效应对机制，但我们发现，对于疫情规模级别的灾难，这一策略并不有效。寻求为日益频繁的大规模灾害做准备的政策制定者将不得不面对这样一个事实：过去给人们带来希望的应对策略，在他们试图应对未来时可能会失效。

articles.title_en: Promises and uncertainties in the cultivated proteins market: Perspectives from Germany and Brazil
articles.title_cn: 培养蛋白市场中的承诺与不确定性：来自德国和巴西的视角
authors: Beatrice de Freitas Martins da Silva
articles.abstract_en: Cultivated meat offers an alternative to ensure food security and mitigate greenhouse gas emissions from conventional animal production. As the innovation remains in its nascent stages, policymakers require a better understanding of the market’s potential, trajectory and future development perspectives. To support policymakers in developing flexible and effective policy frameworks for cultivated meat, we analyze perspectives about the trajectory of the cultivated meat market by 2040 in a comparative study of two countries, which are both major conventional meat markets and developers of alternative protein sources: Brazil and Germany. We use the Q-methodology to identify future perspectives and examine the influence of conventional meat industry incumbents on cultivated meat governance. Our sample includes 59 stakeholders working on cultivated and conventional meat. These perspectives can aid in decision-making related to investments in technological development, improvements in the sensory attributes of cultivated products, support for entrepreneurial ecosystems and startups, product hybridization, consumer and stakeholder engagement, the development of human capital, and regulatory schemes.
articles.abstract_cn: 培养肉提供了一种替代方案，以确保食品安全并减少传统动物生产产生的温室气体排放。由于该创新仍处于初期阶段，政策制定者需要更好地了解市场的潜力、发展轨迹和未来前景。为了支持政策制定者制定灵活有效的培养肉政策框架，我们在一项比较研究中分析了到2040年培养肉市场发展轨迹的视角，研究对象是两个既是传统肉类主要市场又是替代蛋白来源开发者的国家：巴西和德国。我们使用Q方法论来识别未来视角，并考察传统肉类行业现有企业对培养肉治理的影响。我们的样本包括59名从事培养肉和传统肉类的利益相关者。这些视角有助于与技术开发投资、培养产品感官属性改进、创业生态系统和初创企业支持、产品杂交、消费者和利益相关者参与、人力资本开发以及监管方案相关的决策。

articles.title_en: Vulnerability of US dairy farms to extreme heat
articles.title_cn: 美国奶牛场对极端高温的脆弱性
articles.abstract_en: Livestock agriculture, and dairy more specifically, is threatened by climate change as extreme weather conditions become more frequent. When temperature and humidity increase above critical levels, dairy cows become heat-stressed and experience a drop in milk production. We quantify the impact of heat stress on the dairy industry throughout the Midwestern and Eastern United States in the years 2012–2016 using animal-level production data. We estimate that 1% of total annual yield is lost to heat stress, and losses are predicted to increase about 30% by 2050 on average under various climate scenarios. We provide three new insights compared to previous estimates with aggregated data. (1) Heat stress disproportionately affects milk quality, having larger impacts on farm income and nutritional value than previously estimated. (2) Small farms experience the largest losses to heat stress, suggesting they face barriers to adaptation. (3) Cows in the highest-yield production stage are the most vulnerable to heat stress in both relative and absolute terms. Our results have global implications given the prevalence of dairy as a source of income and nutrition in high- and low-income contexts. We outline ways that funds for climate-smart agriculture could be used to increase climate resilience in the dairy industry.
articles.abstract_cn: 畜牧业，尤其是奶牛养殖，正受到气候变化的威胁，因为极端天气事件变得更加频繁。当温度和湿度超过临界水平时，奶牛会遭受热应激，导致产奶量下降。我们利用动物层面的生产数据，量化了2012-2016年间美国中西部和东部地区热应激对奶牛养殖业的影响。我们估计，每年总产量的1%因热应激而损失，并且在各种气候情景下，到2050年损失预计平均增加约30%。与以往使用汇总数据的估计相比，我们提供了三个新见解。（1）热应激对牛奶质量的影响不成比例地大，对农场收入和营养价值的影响比以往估计的更大。（2）小型农场因热应激遭受的损失最大，这表明它们面临适应障碍。（3）处于最高产奶阶段的奶牛在相对和绝对意义上都最容易受到热应激的影响。鉴于奶牛养殖在高低收入环境中作为收入和营养来源的普遍性，我们的结果具有全球意义。我们概述了气候智能型农业资金可用于提高奶牛养殖业气候韧性的途径。

articles.title_en: Consumer support of policy measures to increase sustainability in food consumption
articles.title_cn: 消费者对提高食品消费可持续性的政策措施的支持
articles.abstract_en: The modern global food system is an important driver of climate change. Policy measures are one potential lever for shifting consumption towards more sustainability. Public acceptance can be a major barrier for the implementation of such measures. Thus, a profound understanding of consumers is needed to facilitate policy support. In the present study, we therefore invited 453 participants from German-speaking parts of Switzerland to participate in an online survey in which we tested 15 policy measures for their consumer acceptance. Furthermore, we explored individual predictors that contribute to policy support. Our results show that there is a difference in the support of policy measures depending on the level of intrusiveness, making less intrusive measures more accepted than more intrusive measures. Support also varied depending on the targeted product category. Measures targeting dairy and meat products tended to be less accepted than measures targeting vegetables. Using a regression analysis, we identified behaviour (i.e. meat and dairy consumption) and food sustainability knowledge as an important predictor of policy support. The findings have important implications for policymakers, as they illustrate that personal involvement is a crucial factor in policy support. Taken together, our findings can help inform future food policies to increase consumer support and thereby facilitate sustainable behaviour change.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代全球食品系统是气候变化的重要驱动因素。政策措施是推动消费向更可持续方向转变的一个潜在杠杆。公众接受度可能是实施此类措施的主要障碍。因此，深入了解消费者对于促进政策支持至关重要。在本研究中，我们邀请了来自瑞士德语区的453名参与者参加一项在线调查，测试了15项政策措施的消费者接受度。此外，我们探讨了有助于政策支持的个人预测因素。我们的结果显示，政策措施的支持度因其干预程度的不同而有所差异，干预程度较低的措施比干预程度较高的措施更容易被接受。支持度也因目标产品类别而异。针对乳制品和肉类的措施往往不如针对蔬菜的措施被接受。通过回归分析，我们确定了行为（即肉类和乳制品消费）和食品可持续性知识是政策支持的重要预测因素。这些发现对政策制定者具有重要意义，因为它们表明个人参与是政策支持的关键因素。总的来说，我们的发现可以为未来的食品政策提供信息，以增加消费者支持，从而促进可持续行为改变。

articles.title_en: Can differentiated value-added tax rates promote healthier diets? The case of Costa Rica
articles.title_cn: 差别增值税税率能否促进更健康的饮食？哥斯达黎加的案例
articles.abstract_en: In February 2023, Costa Rica reformed its basic value-added tax basket on which a reduced rate applies to “guarantee a balanced diet”. This paper assesses ex-ante the impact of the reform on nutrient availability and household spending across income groups. Price elasticities are estimated using pooled National Household Income and Expenditure Survey data and a two-step censored quadratic almost ideal demand system model accounting for price and total expenditure endogeneity. Nutritional information is derived from food composition tables. Food items are grouped by processing level as a proxy to explore differences in own- and cross-price effects between ‘healthier’ and ‘less healthy’ items. The demand for ultra-processed sweet and savoury foods is price-inelastic (−0.74 and −0.81, respectively). Lower-income households’ demand is more price-sensitive. The reform applies a reduced rate to a significant number of ultra-processed savoury food items and is associated with an increase in household purchases of calories (0.7%), sugar (0.4%), and saturated fat (1.2%). A counterfactual scenario with a basic tax basket defined based on the Pan American Health Organization nutrient profile model criteria is associated with the largest reductions in calories (−0.2%), sodium (−1.0%), and saturated fat (−0.6%), with higher benefits for lower-income households. It results in minor decreases in household spending (−0.2%). While an increasing number of countries contemplate the taxation of foods high in fat, salt, or sugar, Costa Rica is unique in mandating the consideration of nutritional aspects in determining value-added tax rates. However, the recently adopted basic tax basket may not fulfil this potential.
articles.abstract_cn: 2023年二月，哥斯达黎加改革了其基本增值税篮子，对适用低税率的商品以“保障均衡饮食”。本文事前评估了该改革对不同收入群体营养素可获得性和家庭支出的影响。使用汇总的国家家庭收入与支出调查数据，并采用考虑价格和总支出内生性的两步审查二次几乎理想需求系统模型估计价格弹性。营养信息来源于食物成分表。食品按加工水平分组，作为探索‘更健康’与‘不太健康’商品之间自身和交叉价格效应差异的代理。超加工甜味和咸味食品的需求缺乏价格弹性（分别为-0.74和-0.81）。低收入家庭的需求对价格更敏感。该改革对大量超加工咸味食品适用低税率，并与家庭卡路里（0.7%）、糖（0.4%）和饱和脂肪（1.2%）购买量的增加相关。基于泛美卫生组织营养素概况模型标准定义基本税收篮子的反事实情景，与卡路里（-0.2%）、钠（-1.0%）和饱和脂肪（-0.6%）的最大减少相关，对低收入家庭带来更大益处。这导致家庭支出小幅减少（-0.2%）。虽然越来越多的国家考虑对高脂肪、高盐或高糖食品征税，但哥斯达黎加在确定增值税税率时强制考虑营养方面是独特的。然而，最近采用的基本税收篮子可能无法实现这一潜力。

articles.title_en: Machine learning on national shopping data reliably estimates childhood obesity prevalence and socio-economic deprivation
articles.title_cn: 基于全国购物数据的机器学习可靠估计儿童肥胖患病率与社会经济剥夺
articles.abstract_en: Deprivation pushes people to choose cheap, calorie-dense foods instead of nutritious but expensive alternatives. Diseases, such as obesity, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes, resulting from these poor dietary choices place a significant burden on public health systems. Measuring nutritional insecurity is difficult to achieve at scale and so the ability to study the relationship between nutritional outcomes and deprivation at a national level is very challenging. This makes it difficult to understand the effect of new policies or track changes over time. To address this challenge, we develop a machine learning approach using massive anonymised transactional data (4 million members and 2.5 billion transactions) in partnership with the retailer The Co-operative Group UK. We engineer a series of variables related to obesogenic diets, including a new measure called ‘Calorie-oriented purchasing’. These variables help illustrate how large-scale transactional data can discriminate between neighbourhoods most affected by deprivation and childhood obesity. Through comparative assessment of machine learning approaches, we find better performance from tree-based models (Random Forest, XGBoost) with the best-achieving accuracy of 0.88 for predicting deprivation and an accuracy of 0.79 for childhood obesity. Calorie-oriented purchasing emerges as a robust predictor of deprivation and childhood obesity at the census area level. Results show this approach can help summarise nutritional insecurity, and support its spatio-temporal monitoring. We conclude with policy implications and recommend retailers adopt new measures for measuring national nutrition insecurity.
articles.abstract_cn: 剥夺促使人们选择廉价、高热量的食物，而非营养丰富但昂贵的替代品。由这些不良饮食选择导致的疾病，如肥胖、心血管疾病和糖尿病，给公共卫生系统带来了沉重负担。大规模衡量营养不安全难以实现，因此在全国层面研究营养结果与剥夺之间的关系非常具有挑战性。这使得理解新政策的效果或随时间追踪变化变得困难。为应对这一挑战，我们与零售商The Co-operative Group UK合作，开发了一种机器学习方法，使用大规模匿名交易数据（4百万会员和2.5十亿笔交易）。我们设计了一系列与致肥胖饮食相关的变量，包括一项名为“卡路里导向购买”的新指标。这些变量有助于说明大规模交易数据如何区分受剥夺和儿童肥胖影响最严重的社区。通过机器学习方法的比较评估，我们发现基于树的模型（随机森林、XGBoost）表现更好，预测剥夺的最佳准确率为0.88，预测儿童肥胖的准确率为0.79。卡路里导向购买在人口普查区层面成为剥夺和儿童肥胖的稳健预测因子。结果表明，这种方法有助于总结营养不安全，并支持其时空监测。我们最后提出政策含义，并建议零售商采用新措施来衡量国家营养不安全。

articles.title_en: Where to buy and what to eat: The relationship between purchasing channels and nutrient intake in Japan
articles.title_cn: 在哪里购买与吃什么：日本购买渠道与营养素摄入之间的关系
articles.abstract_en: Interventions in the food environment to improve nutrient intake are often proposed with the goals of reducing obesity and non-communicable diseases. Prior studies exploring relationships between the food environment and nutrient intake have assumed that most purchased food is consumed without examining direct correlations between purchasing channels and nutrient intake. This study addresses this research gap by analyzing correlations between purchasing channels, nutrient intake, and body mass index (BMI) using a unique dataset from Japan combining individual purchase records and nutrient intake data for men and women over 40 years of age. We also introduced a method to assess non-discretionary macronutrient intake ratios—proportions that remain stable across such factors as food access and demographics. Our results reveal a generally weak correlation between purchasing channels and both caloric intake and BMI; however, among individuals who are not overweight, frequent convenience store purchases were linked to lower caloric intake. We identified a non-discretionary macronutrient intake ratio, primarily carbohydrates, of approximately 3.5 % (standard error 9.7 × 10−5) in non-overweight individuals. After accounting for non-discretionary intake ratios, the correlation between purchasing channels and macronutrient intake ratios remained weak. Policies targeting discretionary nutrient intake may have potential to improve overall nutrient consumption, because factors beyond purchasing channels are more likely to influence discretionary intake.
articles.abstract_cn: 旨在改善营养素摄入的食物环境干预措施通常以减少肥胖和非传染性疾病为目标。先前探讨食物环境与营养素摄入之间关系的研究假设大多数购买的食物被消费，而未直接检验购买渠道与营养素摄入之间的相关性。本研究通过使用日本独特的结合个人购买记录和40岁以上男性和女性营养素摄入数据的数据集，分析购买渠道、营养素摄入和体重指数（BMI）之间的相关性，填补了这一研究空白。我们还引入了一种方法来评估非自主性宏量营养素摄入比例——这些比例在食物获取和人口统计学等因素中保持稳定。我们的结果显示，购买渠道与热量摄入和BMI之间的相关性总体较弱；然而，在非超重个体中，频繁的便利店购买与较低的热量摄入相关。我们识别出非超重个体中非自主性宏量营养素摄入比例，主要为碳水化合物，约为3.5（标准误9.7×10−5）。在考虑非自主性摄入比例后，购买渠道与宏量营养素摄入比例之间的相关性仍然较弱。针对自主性营养素摄入的政策可能具有改善整体营养素消费的潜力，因为购买渠道以外的因素更可能影响自主性摄入。

articles.title_en: What’s the Buzz? Preferences and perceptions of policies to reduce childhood energy drink consumption
articles.title_cn: 喧嚣背后？减少儿童能量饮料消费政策的偏好与认知
articles.abstract_en: As global energy drink sales and caffeine content have surged, so have public health concerns over childhood energy drink consumption. With limited regulatory oversight, potential adverse effects, and recent claims of targeted marketing toward children, there is a need to better understand society’s evolving relationship with energy drink markets. This study uses experimental and survey data from a national panel of 1,036 U.S. adults to assess consumer preferences and perceptions toward energy drink policies and marketing. First, we use a best-worst scaling experiment to assess preferences for energy drink labeling requirements, sales channel bans, marketing restrictions, and caffeine caps relative to the status quo. A randomized information treatment also considers how information from health agencies highlighting risks to childhood health affects policy preferences. Without this information, respondents have the strongest preference fora mandatory and prominently displayed caffeine content label. Providing information on the potential childhood health risks, however, increases the relative ranking of policies banning sales to children in retail outlets and high schools. The exploratory survey analysis then provides insights into marketing perceptions that open avenues for future research. For example, we show that it takes the average consumer more than twice as long to find the caffeine content of an energy drink than its calorie count, most consumers believe energy drink packaging is at least somewhat appealing to children, and the perceived target audience of social media marketing varies across brands. These results and the corresponding discussion provide important global policy-relevant insights as the energy drink market develops.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着全球能量饮料销量和咖啡因含量的激增，公众对儿童能量饮料消费的健康担忧也随之增加。在监管有限、潜在不良影响以及近期关于针对儿童定向营销的指控背景下，有必要更好地理解社会与能量饮料市场之间不断演变的关系。本研究利用来自全国1,036名美国成年人的实验和调查数据，评估消费者对能量饮料政策和营销的偏好与认知。首先，我们使用最佳-最差标度实验来评估相对于现状，消费者对能量饮料标签要求、销售渠道禁令、营销限制和咖啡因上限的偏好。一项随机信息处理还考虑了健康机构强调儿童健康风险的信息如何影响政策偏好。在没有这些信息的情况下，受访者对强制且显著展示的咖啡因含量标签有最强的偏好。然而，提供关于潜在儿童健康风险的信息会提高禁止在零售店和高中向儿童销售政策的相对排名。探索性调查分析随后提供了对营销认知的见解，为未来研究开辟了途径。例如，我们表明，普通消费者找到能量饮料咖啡因含量所需的时间是找到其卡路里含量的两倍多，大多数消费者认为能量饮料包装至少在一定程度上对儿童有吸引力，并且社交媒体营销的感知目标受众因品牌而异。这些结果及相应的讨论为能量饮料市场发展提供了重要的全球政策相关见解。

articles.title_en: How does global agricultural research and innovation cooperation influence agricultural R&I system transformation in the South? Evidence from UK-China cooperation
articles.title_cn: 全球农业研究与创新合作如何影响南方农业研发与创新体系转型？来自中英合作的证据
articles.abstract_en: The need for agri-food system transformation has sparked extensive debates on reconfiguring the agricultural research and innovation system (ARIS) to tackle the multidimensional and interwoven challenges present across geographies and scales. This paper highlights the emergence of China, India and Brazil, and their increasing influence on ARIS in the South. We conceptualise global agricultural R&I cooperation (ARIC) to examine how the changing nature of the cooperation between major players from the North and the South influences ARIS transformation in the South. We propose a local–global nexus (LGN) framework to reveal multiple processes involving researchers and non-academic actors for joint knowledge production and social impact across scales. We explore LGN’s feasibility through a case study of UK-China cooperation to illustrate the necessity and key factors influencing the participation of non-academic actors including smallholder farmers in ARIC. Evidence for this paper comes from a combination of primary data collected from 52 British scientists, representatives of funding agencies and entrepreneurs regarding their experiences, opinions and perceptions of ARIC through bilateral cooperation, and second sources. This paper contributes to ARIS transformation debates from three perspectives. First, it sheds new light on transformative innovation debates by adding an ARIC element for ARIS transformation in the South. Second, it enriches a “pathways approach” by delineating four pathways of ARIC, as well as top-down and bottom-up processes across various scales. Third, it offers an LGN framework for ARIC research to address the complexity, diversity and opportunities for ARIS transformation towards sustainable and equitable agri-food systems in the South.
articles.abstract_cn: 农业食品系统转型的需求引发了关于重新配置农业研究与创新体系（ARIS）以应对跨地域和跨尺度的多维交织挑战的广泛讨论。本文强调了中、印、巴的崛起及其对南方ARIS日益增长的影响。我们概念化全球农业研发与创新合作（ARIC），以考察北方与南方主要参与者之间合作性质的变化如何影响南方ARIS的转型。我们提出了一个地方-全球联结（LGN）框架，以揭示涉及研究人员和非学术行动者在跨尺度联合知识生产和社会影响中的多重过程。我们通过中英合作的案例研究探讨LGN的可行性，以说明非学术行动者（包括小农户）参与ARIC的必要性和关键影响因素。本文的证据来自一手数据和二手资料的结合，一手数据收集自52位英国科学家、资助机构代表和企业家，涉及他们通过双边合作对ARIC的经验、观点和看法。本文从三个角度对ARIS转型辩论做出贡献。首先，通过为南方ARIS转型增加ARIC元素，为变革性创新辩论提供了新的视角。其次，通过描绘ARIC的四条路径以及跨尺度的自上而下和自下而上的过程，丰富了“路径方法”。第三，为ARIC研究提供了一个LGN框架，以应对南方ARIS向可持续和公平农业食品系统转型的复杂性、多样性和机遇。

articles.title_en: Cutting VAT rate on food products in a high-inflation environment. Does it work out?
articles.title_cn: 高通胀环境下削减食品增值税税率是否有效？
articles.abstract_en: In February 2022, the Polish government reduced the VAT rate on basic food products from 5% to 0% in order to curb elevated inflation. Using multiple state-of-the-art robust estimators within a dynamic difference-in-differences approach, we estimated that the VAT rate reduction initially contributed to an average 2.1–2.8% decrease in the prices of affected products. Therefore, the immediate pass-through of the tax reduction in retail food prices was limited (only 44.0–58.2%), resulting in a 0.3–0.4 percentage point decrease in headline inflation. The effect of the VAT rate cut reached its peak within 5 months, achieving an almost full pass-through of approximately 94.6%, which led to a reduction in headline inflation by about 0.7 percentage points. We argue that the high effectiveness of the VAT reduction in Poland would not have been possible without the active role of the Office of Competition and Consumer Protection. Lowering VAT rate limited the budgetary revenues by only 0.3% GDP (value equivalent to 0.5% of private consumption), which means that it was a relatively cost-effective tool in providing relief to households in a high-inflation environment, especially for poorer consumers with a higher share of food in total expenditures.
articles.abstract_cn: 2022年二月，波兰政府将基本食品的增值税税率从5%降至0%，以抑制高企的通货膨胀。采用动态双重差分方法中的多种先进稳健估计量，我们估计增值税税率下调最初使受影响产品价格平均下降2.1-2.8%。因此，税收减免在零售食品价格中的即时传导有限（仅为44.0-58.2%），导致总体通胀率下降0.3-0.4个百分点。增值税削减的效果在5个月内达到峰值，实现了约94.6%的几乎完全传导，使总体通胀率下降约0.7个百分点。我们认为，如果没有竞争与消费者保护局的积极作用，波兰增值税削减的高效性是不可能实现的。降低增值税税率仅使预算收入减少GDP的0.3%（相当于私人消费的0.5%），这意味着在高通胀环境下，这是一种相对成本效益较高的工具，为家庭提供救济，尤其是对食品支出占比较高的贫困消费者而言。

articles.title_en: The effect of food price upsurges on income inequality: The richest win and the poorest lose
articles.title_cn: 食品价格上涨对收入不平等的影响：最富者获益，最穷者受损
articles.abstract_en: From a theoretical perspective, the ultimate effect that food price shocks may have on inequality is ambiguous. Food price shocks, indeed, generate both winners and losers and their overall impact on income distribution cannot be predicted a priori but depends on the relative magnitude of different effects. From the empirical perspective, however, the link between international food prices and income distribution is largely understudied. The present paper tries to fill the gap by analyzing a large sample of 126 developing and developed countries observed in the period 1990–2020 and studying how food price shocks are associated with changes in income distribution. The heterogeneity of the effect is investigated by means of interaction terms accounting for the food trade balance of countries and the structure of the agricultural sector, coming to three main conclusions. First, upsurging food prices increase inequality by affecting the relative income of the poorest 50 percent of the population to the advantage of richer people, especially of the richest among the rich. Second, this effect is relevant for developing countries while no clear findings emerge for high-income countries. Third, the disequalizing effect of soaring international food prices is not uniform in developing countries but largely depends on their food trade balance and some structural attributes of their agricultural sector. In this regard, food policy must reduce the domestic transmission of price shocks to poor consumers while strengthening farmers’ productive capacity and ability to cope with the shocks through better access to land, capital and productive resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 从理论角度看，食品价格冲击对不平等可能产生的最终影响是不确定的。实际上，食品价格冲击既会产生赢家也会产生输家，其对收入分配的总体影响无法事先预测，而是取决于不同效应的相对大小。然而，从实证角度看，国际食品价格与收入分配之间的联系在很大程度上尚未得到充分研究。本文试图通过分析1990-2020年期间观察到的126个发展中国家和发达国家的大样本，并研究食品价格冲击如何与收入分配变化相关联，来填补这一空白。通过考虑国家食品贸易平衡和农业部门结构的交互项来研究效应的异质性，得出三个主要结论。第一，食品价格上涨通过影响最贫困的50%人口的相对收入，使较富裕人群，尤其是最富者中的最富者受益，从而加剧了不平等。第二，这种效应对发展中国家显著，而对高收入国家则没有明确的发现。第三，国际食品价格飙升的不平等效应在发展中国家并非一致，而在很大程度上取决于其食品贸易平衡和农业部门的一些结构性特征。在这方面，食品政策必须减少价格冲击对贫困消费者的国内传导，同时通过改善土地、资本和生产资源的获取来增强农民的生产能力和应对冲击的能力。
